CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement, and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE's power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing, and healthcare. With engineering know-how and responsive worldwide service and support, the company builds collaborative partnerships to meet evolving technology requirements, drive customer growth, and innovate the future of power.
